Here is a simple YAML Semgrep rule for the vulnerability-fixing evidence you provided:

```yaml
---
id: "vuln-portofino-94653cb3"
title: "Potential temporary file creation vulnerability in WarFileLauncher class"
description: "This rule checks if a temporary directory is created using File.createTempFile(). It should be replaced with Files.createTempDirectory() to avoid potential security issues."
severity: WARNING
language: java
type: taint-mode
taint-mode:
  - method: WarFileLauncher#createTempDir
    pattern: "java/io/File#createTempFile"
    args:
      - "portofino.tomcat."
      - ".\\d+"
metadata:
  CVEs: ["CVE-2022-3952"]
  CWEs: [CWE-377, CWE-668]
---
```

This rule will match any call to `File.createTempFile()` with the specified pattern and issue a warning if found. The pattern `"java/io/File#createTempFile"` matches the method signature of `File.createTempFile()`. The arguments `"portofino.tomcat."` and `.\\d+` are used to match any string that starts with "portofino.tomcat." followed by one or more digits.

Please note that this rule is a basic example and might need adjustments depending on the specifics of your codebase.
